reviewed_artifact.preservation_rule: The reviewed v3 campaign artifact remains unchanged. This file is a candidate-scoped later advisory delta and does not rewrite its historical packets or statuses.

candidate_boundary.retained_claim: FOLR-Core is a deterministic lifecycle, state-admission and delayed-credit transducer for an unchanged base MARL learner under authoritative changing-membership events.
non_claims: It does not learn membership management or lifecycle decisions.
It adds no reward, intrinsic objective, exploration policy or learned release gate.
It assumes no state portability across an ownership epoch boundary.
It does not include optional restoration or SCOPE-1S.
A conformance pass is not evidence of return, sample-efficiency, coordination or generalization benefit.
candidate_boundary.base_learner_contract: Policy, critic, optimizer, task reward and ordinary exploration are unchanged; Core changes only admissible history, state continuity, masks and action-instance credit ownership.

conformance_claim.text: For every trace inside the registered authoritative-event contract, FOLR-Core admits no stale or wrong-owner state, action, message or learner update; never transfers state through slot reuse or an epoch boundary; and resolves or explicitly cancels every admitted action receipt without duplicate consumption.

downstream_marl_claim.text: Conditional on a complete conformance pass, the full continuation-plus-origin-credit Core can improve normalized primitive-time team return over the complete post-event roster spell relative to matched MaskReset under held-out partner policies.
downstream_marl_claim.interpretation_limit: This claim is restricted to the registered task, roster-event and held-out-partner populations. It cannot be inferred from conformance, mechanism counters or training-partner results alone.

claim_split.claim_precedence: Any conformance failure blocks every downstream interpretation.

authoritative_inputs: unique lifecycle event id and monotone event sequence
owner- and epoch-tagged observations and messages
legal action mask available at action admission

registered_symbols.owner_id: Authenticated persistent pseudonym. At most one epoch for an owner may be active in a team trace.
registered_symbols.slot_id: Reusable physical position with no ownership or state-continuity meaning.
registered_symbols.owner_epoch: Strictly increasing positive integer per owner. Every accepted join while inactive, including rejoin, creates a new epoch.
registered_symbols.roster_version: Strictly increasing integer advanced once by each accepted nonduplicate lifecycle transaction.
registered_symbols.event_seq: Strictly increasing team-trace lifecycle sequence; gaps quarantine the trace until resolved.
registered_symbols.action_instance_id: Unique immutable id assigned once at action admission and never reused.
registered_symbols.D_outcome_max: Finite maximum action-to-terminal-outcome latency declared by the environment before validation.
registered_symbols.D_event_replay_max: Finite maximum duplicate-event or duplicate-outcome replay latency declared before validation.
registered_symbols.B_tombstone: max(D_outcome_max, D_event_replay_max) plus one logical boundary.

scientific_transducer.binding_gate: No trace or stochastic validation is admissible until D_outcome_max, D_event_replay_max, the boundary ordering and the in-flight-action rule are finite and frozen for that environment.

total_order_contract.selection_rule: Exactly one mode is frozen per environment binding; the adversarial conformance suite exercises both as separate bindings.
total_order_contract.same_phase_tie_break: Unique source sequence, then unique event or action-instance id. A remaining tie is a contract conflict and quarantines action and learner admission.
total_order_contract.policy_version_rule: Learner consumption precedes current action admission, and each new receipt stores the policy version actually used after that boundary's registered learner step.

event_definitions.join: An inactive authenticated owner becomes active in an unused slot and receives a fresh owner epoch.
event_definitions.leave: The currently active owner and epoch in a slot become inactive; the epoch is permanently closed.
event_definitions.replacement: One atomic transaction closes the current owner epoch and activates a different owner with that owner's fresh epoch in the same slot.
event_definitions.rejoin: A previously seen but currently inactive owner joins after an absence; it is a join with a fresh epoch and no cross-epoch state read.
event_definitions.slot_reuse: Any later activation in a previously used slot. Slot history has no read permission.
event_definitions.duplicate: The same event id, sequence and payload is delivered again; it is an idempotent no-op.
event_definitions.stale: A nonduplicate lifecycle event has an event sequence below the next required sequence; it is rejected with no state effect.
event_definitions.conflict: An event id is reused with a different payload, an owner is activated twice, a slot has two active owners, or an event sequence gap exists; the affected trace is quarantined fail-closed.

state_dependency_manifest.action_effect: Authoritative gate only; not an actor feature unless every arm receives the identical declared feature.

scientific_transducer.manifest_completeness_rule: Every concrete action- or update-affecting variable must bind to exactly one S01-S14 class before validation. An unbound or multiply bound variable is unreadable, nonpersistent and a conformance failure; it cannot be silently assigned by implementation convenience.

lifecycle_transition_table.precondition: inactive owner; unused active slot; next event sequence
lifecycle_transition_table.transition: increment owner epoch; bind owner and new epoch to slot; increment roster version; initialize S03 and S08; clear or rebuild S04-S07
lifecycle_transition_table.receipt_effect: none for prior epochs except their already registered FSM state

lifecycle_transition_table.precondition: same event id, sequence and payload was already accepted
lifecycle_transition_table.transition: no state, mask, epoch, receipt or counter change

lifecycle_transition_table.precondition: matching active owner, epoch and slot; next event sequence
lifecycle_transition_table.transition: close epoch permanently; unbind slot; increment roster version; make leaving-owner S03-S08 unreadable; preserve S03 and S08 only for uninterrupted survivors; rebuild survivor S04-S07
lifecycle_transition_table.receipt_effect: apply the frozen in-flight-action rule to every OPEN receipt of the closed epoch

lifecycle_transition_table.precondition: active old owner in slot; different inactive new owner; next event sequence
lifecycle_transition_table.transition: atomically perform old-owner leave then new-owner join in one roster-version transition; new owner receives a fresh epoch
lifecycle_transition_table.receipt_effect: old receipts retain old immutable origin and follow the in-flight rule

lifecycle_transition_table.precondition: previously seen owner is inactive; target slot unused; next event sequence
lifecycle_transition_table.transition: increment owner epoch; initialize all owner-private state fresh; never read a prior epoch; rebuild roster-dependent state
lifecycle_transition_table.receipt_effect: prior-epoch receipts remain prior-epoch records only

lifecycle_transition_table.precondition: slot was used earlier but is currently unused; incoming owner inactive; next event sequence
lifecycle_transition_table.transition: process as JOIN or REJOIN from owner identity; slot history supplies no state

lifecycle_transition_table.precondition: nonduplicate event sequence below the next required sequence
lifecycle_transition_table.transition: reject with no state effect and log stale-event witness

lifecycle_transition_table.precondition: event sequence above the next required sequence, contradictory duplicate, active owner joined again, occupied slot joined, or owner/epoch mismatch
lifecycle_transition_table.transition: quarantine the affected team trace; admit no action, message or learner update until authoritative reconciliation
lifecycle_transition_table.receipt_effect: existing receipts remain immutable; terminal outcomes may be logged but not consumed while quarantined

allowed_bindings.rule: Every OPEN receipt owned by the closing epoch becomes CANCELLED_NO_LEARN. A later outcome is rejected against the tombstone and has no learner effect.
Every OPEN receipt owned by the closing epoch becomes DETACHED_OPEN. A later outcome may resolve only that immutable receipt and may update only the shared learner, never current owner-private state.

in_flight_action_contract.selection_rule: Exactly one binding is frozen per environment. Missing, mixed or action-dependent undeclared semantics are ineligible.

observation_message_action_admission.admit_if: owner and epoch are currently active; roster version equals the ledger; observation is current and nonduplicate
observation_message_action_admission.otherwise: reject with no recurrent-state or normalization update

observation_message_action_admission.admit_if: sender and receiver owner epochs are current and active; message roster version is current; edge is legal; payload is not stale
observation_message_action_admission.otherwise: reject with no edge-cache, receiver-state or normalization update

observation_message_action_admission.admit_if: owner epoch is current and active; trace not quarantined; representation input is valid; selected action is legal under the current legal-action mask
observation_message_action_admission.otherwise: no environment action and no receipt creation

observation_message_action_admission.admit_if: an immutable receipt is RESOLVED_READY, its outcome action id matches, and consumption count is zero
observation_message_action_admission.otherwise: no learner sample or optimizer contribution; current active roster is never used to reassign origin

action_receipt_schema.uniqueness: One action_instance_id creates at most one receipt; immutable-field mutation is a conformance failure.

retention.open_or_detached: Retain through B_open. If no outcome arrives by the deadline, transition once to EXPIRED_CANCELLED.
retention.resolved_ready: Must be consumed at the next registered learner-admission boundary; missing that boundary is a conformance failure and quarantines further learner admission.
retention.terminal: Retain a digest tombstone through B_tombstone; an outcome with an unknown or expired id is rejected fail-closed.

receipt_fsm.input: valid action admission with fresh action id

receipt_fsm.effect: reject duplicate action admission; no second receipt
retain immutable origin; prohibit owner-private-state write

receipt_fsm.input: first matching terminal outcome before deadline
receipt_fsm.effect: bind outcome once to the receipt; no current-slot lookup
terminal registered cancellation and missing-outcome witness
create exactly one action-origin-tagged update record; consumption_count becomes one
reject duplicate with no payload or count change
reject against tombstone; consumption_count remains one
reject against tombstone; no learner effect

typed_mask_semantics.representation_mask: One only for current active owner epochs with a current valid observation; controls feature participation and recurrence writes.
typed_mask_semantics.communication_mask: One only for current active sender-receiver epochs with a current legal message; controls physical or model message influence.
typed_mask_semantics.action_mask: Intersection of current active owner-epoch eligibility and the environment legal-action mask; controls environment action and receipt creation.
typed_mask_semantics.credit_mask: One only for RESOLVED_READY immutable receipts eligible for exactly-once learner admission; it is receipt-indexed and need not equal current activity.
typed_mask_semantics.collapse_rule: Two masks may share one implementation only after an equality witness proves identical domains and transitions; decorative duplication is forbidden.

registered_invariants: I01 accepted lifecycle transactions are atomic and exact duplicates are idempotent
I02 each owner has at most one active epoch and every activation while inactive creates a strictly newer epoch
I03 slot reuse never grants access to a prior owner or epoch state
I04 only S03 and S08 of uninterrupted survivor epochs may persist across a roster change
I05 every S04-S07 object is invalidated or rebuilt before the next affected action
I06 stale, wrong-epoch or quarantined observations, messages and events have no action or learner effect
I07 an inactive or wrong-epoch owner cannot act
I08 each admitted action creates at most one immutable receipt
I09 a delayed outcome resolves only its originating action instance and never the current slot occupant
I10 each resolved receipt is consumed exactly once or reaches one registered cancellation state
I11 no receipt consumption writes owner-private state of a closed epoch
I12 every concrete action- or update-affecting state variable has exactly one manifest binding

primary_conformance.definition: Probability that a complete trace from the frozen registered lifecycle-trace population contains at least one I01-I12 violation.
primary_conformance.pass_rule: zero observed violations in every frozen adversarial trace; any violation is terminal for downstream interpretation
primary_conformance.uncertainty_rule: No stochastic interval substitutes for conformance. Coverage is justified by the explicit trace matrix and zero-tolerance witnesses.

primary_downstream_marl.definition: Expected paired independent-run-block difference Y_FullCore minus Y_MaskReset.
primary_downstream_marl.outcome: Y is normalized mean primitive-time team reward over the complete roster spell beginning immediately after an accepted lifecycle-event cluster and ending immediately before the next accepted lifecycle cluster or episode termination.
primary_downstream_marl.normalization: Each primitive reward is mapped to [0,1] using environment-declared fixed r_min and r_max; an environment without finite frozen bounds is ineligible for this estimand.
primary_downstream_marl.event_aggregation: Compute one mean per event-type stratum, then weight JOIN, LEAVE, REPLACEMENT, REJOIN and SLOT_REUSE equally at 0.2 so event frequency or spell duration cannot select the result.
primary_downstream_marl.population: Frozen task and membership generator with the five registered event strata, authoritative event delivery, bounded outcome delay, and partner policies drawn only from a held-out policy-family set disjoint from all training families.
primary_downstream_marl.horizon: one complete post-event roster spell in primitive environment time; simultaneous lifecycle events are one event cluster and no event is dropped because another event later shortens the spell
primary_downstream_marl.interpretation_limit: Supports only incremental post-event return inside the registered population after conformance and matching pass; it does not establish general MARL superiority or literature novelty.

matching_table.parameters: identical policy and critic parameter count and initialization
matching_table.state_capacity: identical allocated owner, roster and inert-buffer bytes

component_factorial.single_factor_rule: After common sanitation, each adjacent arm pair differs only in S or C. A failed matching witness blocks causal attribution.

sampling_uncertainty_and_failure.top_level_unit: one independent training-run block containing all four arms under a preassigned paired task, roster and partner-policy draw
sampling_uncertainty_and_failure.nested_units: episodes, event spells, agents, actions and receipts are nested observations and are never counted as independent algorithm replications
sampling_uncertainty_and_failure.partner_sampling_level: partner-policy family is a crossed block factor; multiple policies or episodes from one family remain nested within the training-run block
sampling_uncertainty_and_failure.held_out_requirement: all primary psi_core evaluation families are disjoint from policy families used to train any arm or write any recurrent state
sampling_uncertainty_and_failure.uncertainty_procedure: Report the paired run-block effect and a two-sided 95 percent confidence interval obtained by exact inversion of within-block arm-label randomization; no episode-level resampling or optional stopping.
sampling_uncertainty_and_failure.equivalence_margin: delta_eq=0.02 on normalized mean primitive reward. Equivalence requires the complete 95 percent interval for the paired difference to lie inside [-0.02,0.02]; nonsignificance alone is not equivalence.
sampling_uncertainty_and_failure.factorial_effects: Report paired S main effect, C main effect and S-by-C interaction from the same independent run blocks with the same interval rule. These are explanatory contrasts; psi_core remains the sole downstream primary estimand.
sampling_uncertainty_and_failure.cohort_rule: The independent-block count and all randomization assignments must be frozen before any outcome is observed. This advisory delta does not authorize or choose a compute budget.

shared_information_boundary: Every arm receives the same lifecycle event at the same logical boundary.
Persistent owner tokens and epochs are available to every arm's sanitation layer; actor visibility is identical and frozen.
No arm receives a future join, leave, replacement, rejoin or outcome.
Policy version, legal-mask digest and receipt status are audit and learner-routing fields, never anticipatory actor features.
Outcome delivery time and payload are identical across arms.
Receipt archive size, retention and inspection opportunities are identical; C alone controls the delayed sample's learner weight.
Partner identity is not an actor feature unless identically exposed in every arm and explicitly included in the claim.

held_out_partner_crossing.training_side: All learning and recurrent-state writing use partner policies from frozen P_train families.
held_out_partner_crossing.evaluation_side: Primary evaluation replaces a departed partner with a policy from disjoint P_holdout while matching declared role, observable capability envelope, action interface and roster-event stratum.
held_out_partner_crossing.interpretation: A training-only benefit is same-partner convention retention. A held-out benefit is consistent with, but does not alone prove, portable survivor-private continuity.

advisory_validation_contract.stage_a_pass_rule: Every I01-I12 invariant holds with zero violations for every frozen trace and both boundary-order bindings. Any failure stops before Stage B.
advisory_validation_contract.stage_b_design: Run the frozen 2x2 S-by-C factorial under the complete matching table, the five equally weighted event strata and the held-out partner-policy crossing.
advisory_validation_contract.named_simple_fallback: MaskReset with fresh owner epochs, full owner-private and roster-dependent reset after each roster change, current-roster sanitation, and minimum receipt tombstones that cancel rather than misroute objectively late credit.
advisory_validation_contract.scope_after_success: An advisory lifecycle and credit mechanism under the registered event contract only; no formal workflow, implementation, compute, novelty or portfolio-promotion consequence.

campaign_reported_source_facts: The absorbed corpus contains variable-cardinality sets, masks, modular routing, fixed-scenario transfer, event-clock history, stale-observation rejection, action-continuation proxies, partner-drift beliefs and restart boundaries.
The absorbed source set did not establish online join, leave, rejoin, slot-reuse ownership or selective survivor persistence.

residual_uncertainty: Trusted complete lifecycle events and authenticated ownership remain prerequisites rather than learned capabilities.
The concrete base learner may contain an action-affecting variable that fails the S01-S14 binding gate.
A recurrent state may mix self-history and teammate convention, leaving no nontrivial S03 state to preserve.
Environment-specific continuing-action semantics may make cancellation or detached resolution inappropriate until explicitly bound.
Receipt matching can equalize archive bytes and schedules without equalizing every optimizer-geometry consequence of a zero-weight sample.
The held-out crossing isolates policy convention at matched capability but does not establish transport across capabilities, protocols, roster sizes or event laws.
Full reset can remain sufficient in environments without persistent self-state or delayed credit.
Cross-epoch restoration remains deliberately outside FOLR-Core.
